title: Independent CI Remediation Evaluation — Anonymous Convex WorkOS and Tenant Bootstrap

evidence.bootstrap_scope: pass — the helper accepts only the local-ci literal, uses the unique by_slug index, idempotently reuses the isolated organization, and creates only the active tenant required by anonymous lead-intake validation

evidence.workos_configuration: pass — all AuthKit inputs required by the application are present; only deployment-scoped values are copied into the anonymous Convex deployment, while cookie and redirect inputs remain scoped to the local Next.js process; external effects remain disabled
evidence.workflow_safety: pass — set -euo pipefail, bounded readiness loops, child-process liveness checks, the pre-existing Convex readiness condition, non-empty tenant ID validation, failure logs, and unconditional local-process cleanup are preserved
evidence.tenant_binding: pass — the internal mutation returns a real Convex organizations ID and the workflow exports it as NEXT_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION_ID before building, so anonymous leads remain bound to requireActiveOrganization instead of using an unscoped fixture
evidence.protected_preview_gate: pass — preview-verification.yml, release-verification.yml, and deployment environment validation are unchanged between parent and candidate; local fake credentials neither satisfy nor replace the protected-preview WorkOS, Convex, Blob, exact-head, or owner-approval gates

evidence.full_verification: pass — exact detached commit at E:/DevCaches/verify-v4-137f2ee passed skills, environment, assets, ESLint, TypeScript, 18 Vitest suites / 103 tests, and the Next.js 16.2.12 Turbopack production build

evidence.commit_integrity: pass — candidate has exactly parent 20fa1e5b3504b87255a475280ff71c2b57cc589a, the detached checkout was clean, and git show --check reported no whitespace errors
evidence.context7: pass — current official Convex documentation confirms internal-function visibility and trusted CLI invocation; current AuthKit Next.js documentation confirms required local inputs and environment-specific credential isolation
evidence.frontend_policy: not applicable — no frontend component or page was modified, so raw Tailwind color and operational-claim checks have no changed surface

release_gates: Require the Lead Intake E2E GitHub Actions job to pass on exact commit 9e90ed9634fbb10076f06af060a2a96e7a85af92 after publication; the GitHub-hosted anonymous local Convex lifecycle was not reproduced inside this Windows evaluator session.

Keep exact-head CI, Security, Vercel Preview readiness, independent approval, and owner approval gates green before merge or release.
